description: TC Holder must match across the assist letter/STC, the application letter, and the PMA supplement.
findingText: The TC Holder does not match across all three documents (assist letter or STC, application letter paragraph 1 or table, and PMA supplement).
resolutionHint: Reconcile the TC Holder name so all three documents agree.
limitations: Exact text comparison; it cannot judge whether two spellings denote the same legal entity.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
